study.question: After fixed history compression, does jointly preserving temporal and feedback-stratum identity improve target/context/task prediction beyond widened heads receiving their collapsed totals?
study.hypothesis: The incumbent preserves thirty target-scored summaries but discards positive-versus-other identity when it adds the two feedback strata. Retaining their signed difference conditional on their total can expose behavior-specific target/field content at no extra scorer or embedding cost. Temporal and behavior identity may be complementary. This is a hypothesis about final information flow, not a claim that feedback-aware grouping alone works or that auxiliary tasks will recover.

nearest_work.difference: Exact-version primary text lines250-277 describes candidate-conditioned unnormalized activation pooling. We inherit this adapted scorer, but retain compressed age/behavior totals and contrasts for four task heads; not an exact DIN reproduction or priority claim.

Pinned benchmark lines129-237 separates recent/earlier sequences and summarizes them with feature/fixed queries before heterogeneous mixing. Temporal retention is inherited from g2-r0013-recent_separate. Here fixed union-feedback strata and linear sum/difference readouts feed a small context/target residual MLP; no learned queries or HeteroMixer are added. Original-paper equivalence and novelty remain unverified.

Pinned benchmark lines203-274 compresses local groups with InnerTrans and interacts merged history with recent/nonsequence queries. This suite freezes means/scorer and replaces post-scoring readout information only; it does not reproduce learned group compression or repeated attention.

study.proposed_difference: Observed evidence: g2-r0013 recent separate minus collapsed click AUC is +0.0008631141856656; equal separate minus collapsed is +0.0021631957575967. These same-seed factorial observations support temporal retention conditionally, without independent repetition. The incumbent still has cart/fav/buy AUC0.712747/0.728398/0.675200 versus baseline0.849070/0.864897/0.870182; shared-source blocking is a major alternative explanation. Earlier g2-r0002 uniform_feedback lowered click relative to uniform_uniform while improving auxiliary AUC, so behavior grouping is not assumed beneficial to every task. The costly g2-r0005-private_residual recovered auxiliary metrics but failed to improve its click parent and used56321669 parameters/435s, and g2-r0006-exact_blocked count readout did not improve parent click; neither is evidence for the current content readout. Target routers and full100 also did not outperform the later recent layout. New code keeps compression and scoring unchanged: for scored weighted summaries S[j,k]=count[j,k]*activation[j,k]*mean[j,k], k=(all,other,positive), form totals U=sum_j S[j,all], N=sum_j S[j,other], P=sum_j S[j,positive], F=N+P, B=P-N. Existing age contrast is sum_j age_sign[j]*S[j,k] with +1 for final10 positions and -1 for older positions. Click base features remain [context,target,U], auxiliary base features remain [gated_context,gated_target,F]. Every widened residual head reads [base_features, age_view, F, behavior_view]. age_view is the corresponding route age contrast or duplicate route total; behavior_view is B or duplicate F. Auxiliary reads use only the existing functional detached scorer/item/action path; click uses primary scorer outputs. F is common in all four cells, so behavior contrasts condition on the same nonlinear stratified total, rather than confusing B with a change in scoring route. Head width32 and original towers stay fixed; head input expands from input_width+V to input_width+3V, adding 256*V parameters to the incumbent (28672 if V112). Compute both alternatives before selection in every cell. Last head layer starts zero; compare initial inherited keys/state and logits to fresh ancestral construction, but do not demand equality of widened head weights to different-shaped ancestor heads. Before host training: check FP32/BF16 finite forward/backward on full/partial/empty/holey histories, B1 evaluation and B>=2 training; validate all four label mappings, count conservation and independent explicit-row pooling; padded-ID/padded-task-mask invariance and target-action exclusion; confirm U,F,B,age formulas and (F+B)/2=P,(F-B)/2=N with appropriate BF16 tolerances; swapping positive/other scored strata preserves F and negates B; all cells have identical initial parameters/RNG and inherited state, identical initial logits because residual outputs are zero; altered unused contrast coordinates cannot affect collapsed forward outputs or their derivatives. Check auxiliary scorer/item/action gradients remain blocked while context/head gradients survive, and click can train the selected primary strata paths; verify embedding alias/optimizer ownership. Preserve occupied scorer zero/one-row rules, cloned auxiliary buffers and primary-only persistent Dice updates. Empty histories produce zero U/F/B/age under common weights; population-level training effects can still differ. All checks, failed attempts and costs belong to host ledger; local environment offers static/algebra checks only.
predictions: Primary prediction: age_behavior exceeds age_only on full-population validation click AUC; report behavior_only versus totals_only as the second simple effect, without cherry-picking.

Temporal information predicts age_behavior>behavior_only and age_only>totals_only on click AUC. A positive difference-in-differences is the stronger complementarity prediction, not required for independent additive benefits.

Exploratory auxiliary prediction: behavior retention improves some auxiliary AUC/Logloss relative to each matched collapsed control; source blocking can still dominate. Report all three tasks and their mean separately; no claim of restored multi-task parity without measured recovery.

No new compression or scorer capacity is required. Head arithmetic/parameters increase over the incumbent; equal-resource efficiency and any speed claim require measured host results, not operation counting.
falsifiers: Behavior detail fails to improve click in either matched age pair, or loses its advantage in later authorized paired repetitions.
Temporal simple effects disappear under the common F path, or interaction is null/negative: this challenges complementarity but does not erase previous conditional observations.
All widened variants, including totals_only, improve similarly: generic capacity/conditioning or common F is sufficient and the proposed retained-information mechanism is unsupported.
Any numerical/masking/gradient/buffer prerequisite fails: an implementation failure must be repaired or recorded, not scored as scientific counterevidence.
Click improves but auxiliaries stay much below DIN or latency/cost grows disproportionately: this is a scoped click tradeoff, not successful joint-task retention or efficiency.
alternative_explanations: The duplicate controls have lower functional input rank and different optimization conditioning despite equal parameters and dense operators.

The new common F path lets click gradients use stratified scores in every cell, unlike the incumbent. Thus incumbent comparisons combine readout/capacity/gradient changes; only within-suite contrasts identify the declared information replacements.
Historical positive is a union over cart/fav/buy; individual feedback semantics and age-by-behavior joint cells are still merged.
One fixed seed and one epoch give preliminary local evidence; no user-cluster interval or mechanism repetition is yet available.

The first-layer ReLU head can exploit magnitude, noise or count proxies rather than behavioral semantics; B is content-weighted, not a pure feedback count. Earlier null count experiments do not exclude that explanation.
Auxiliary label semantics involve same-user/category/brand within24h; union exposure feedback and click-trained embeddings may not encode the relevant task signal. No current label enters forward.
Recent sign uses fixed exposure indices90..99, not event-time recency. Production causal availability is not established under released official_offline feedback.
